question: Find the difference in total comment counts between posts owned by the oldest user and those owned by users from New York who have earned both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges.

prediction.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments AS c JOIN posts AS p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026" WHERE p."XCL_033" = (SELECT "XCL_052" FROM users ORDER BY "XCL_054" ASC LIMIT 1)) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments AS c JOIN posts AS p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026" WHERE p."XCL_033" IN (SELECT u."XCL_052" FROM users AS u WHERE u."XCL_058" = 'New York' AND u."XCL_052" IN (SELECT b."XCL_002" FROM badges AS b WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher') AND u."XCL_052" IN (SELECT b."XCL_002" FROM badges AS b WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Supporter'))) AS difference

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM comments c
   JOIN posts p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
   WHERE p."XCL_033" = (SELECT "XCL_052" FROM users ORDER BY "XCL_054" ASC LIMIT 1))
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM comments c
   JOIN posts p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
   WHERE p."XCL_033" IN (
       SELECT u."XCL_052"
       FROM users u
       WHERE u."XCL_058" = 'New York'
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052" AND b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher')
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052" AND b."XCL_003" = 'Supporter')
   )) AS difference

   JOIN posts p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
   WHERE p."XCL_033" = (SELECT "XCL_052" FROM users ORDER BY "XCL_054" ASC LIMIT 1))

   FROM comments c
   JOIN posts p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
   WHERE p."XCL_033" IN (
